ui_bugs.issue: Admin appends a new <meta name=robots content='noindex, nofollow'> but does NOT remove/replace the pre-existing <meta name=robots content='index, follow, ...'> that ships in public/index.html. Result: /admin ends up with TWO conflicting robots metas. Most crawlers pick the more restrictive one so functionally OK, but is a real SEO hygiene bug. Fix: in Admin.jsx useEffect, either querySelector('meta[name=robots]') and update its content (restore on cleanup), or remove the head-level default before appending the noindex one.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx useEffect (line ~187), replace the existing meta[name=robots] instead of appending a second one, so /admin has a single robots meta with 'noindex, nofollow'. Everything else on the review checklist passes as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_contact honeypot correctly returns the Contact object without persisting when website is non-empty (early return before insert_one). Good.
Rate limit uses db.contact_rate with TTL index expireAfterSeconds=600 and a plain 'ip' index; count_documents window filter is correct. TTL cleanup means legitimate users unblock automatically.

client_ip() takes first token of x-forwarded-for — matches the review contract. Ingress on the preview does NOT prepend/override our XFF (verified: 5 sends with 198.51.100.77 then 6th got 429; a different XFF got 200), so isolation works.
ServicePage JSON-LD effect appends 3 scripts on mount and removes them on unmount; homepage renders its 1 script inline via React 19 head hoisting — nav-back returns to exactly 1 as required. Good.
Admin.jsx robots meta append is a small SEO hygiene bug (2 conflicting metas). See action_items.

rca_of_the_issue: Admin robots meta bug RCA: Admin.jsx does document.head.appendChild(newRobotsMeta) without first removing the existing meta[name=robots] injected via public/index.html. Reproduction: navigate to /admin, run document.querySelectorAll('meta[name=robots]') in console — returns 2 nodes. Mitigation: change the useEffect to (a) capture existing = document.querySelector('meta[name=robots]'), (b) save existing.content, (c) set existing.content='noindex, nofollow', (d) on cleanup restore the original content — avoids DOM churn and guarantees a single canonical robots tag.
